note: Triennial election of Kilkeel rural district council and board of guardians, one member for each of nineteen divisions; nominations received by Mr. J. J. Bell, returning officer, on Thursday 1 May 1930. Fifteen divisions had a single nomination; in Glasdrumman the second candidate withdrew and in Maghera the second nomination was invalid. Ballymartin and Rostrevor were polled on Friday 30 May 1930 (Irish News, 31 May 1930, p. 5: 'Polling took place on Friday for the Rostrevor Division'); the Newry Telegraph reports the new council as 11 Nationalists and 8 Unionists. Filed on 1930-05-30, the Co. Down county and rural district polling day that year (previously filed under 1930-06-05; moved 6 Nov 2026). x = old member, as printed. 312 voted out of 343 on the register; not a single spoiled vote.
